purpose: Declarative public contract for the project_work thematic routing facade.

tools.name: project_work
tools.description: Thematic project-work routing facade. Use this as the first-contact surface for common project work requests such as next priority, continue task, create/save an improvement task, review capture drafts, close tail, save checkpoint, or route verification/restart work. It classifies intent, returns routing evidence, executes safe read-only routes, and plans guarded mutations unless allow_mutation=true.

intent.description: Natural-language project-work request or operator intent

task_id.description: Optional task id when the request belongs to a known task

state.description: Optional current task state used for routing evidence

summary.description: Optional work summary for checkpoint/closeout routes

raw_notes.description: Optional raw notes for capture/checkpoint routes

draft_id.description: Checkpoint draft id for approve/reject draft routes

version.description: Checkpoint draft version for approve/reject draft routes

reason.description: Optional reason for mutating lifecycle routes

allow_mutation.description: When false, mutating routes return a plan instead of writing memory or changing lifecycle state.

diagnostic.description: Return a compact plain-text route diagnostic block for local/weak MCP clients.

answer.description: Return a final-answer-shaped plain-text block for small local models.

response_format.description: Use diagnostic for route/scorer/telemetry fields or answer for a short final-answer-shaped plain-text block instead of nested JSON.

scorer_backend.description: Route scorer backend. auto keeps deterministic lexical strong matches and uses cheap LLM disambiguation when no explicit route is found; lexical forces deterministic-only routing.

detail.description: Detail level for read-only route execution

owner_agent.description: Task lease owner identity for lifecycle routes. Defaults to agent_id.

session_id.description: Stable caller session identity required by lifecycle routes when no validated work_token can recover continuity.

work_id.description: Concrete work session id used to resume or finish lifecycle work after process/session restart.

agent_fingerprint.description: Stable non-secret agent fingerprint used by task reclaim policy.

runtime_profile_id.description: Runtime capability profile used by task reclaim policy; it must not encode a specific IDE or shell.

work_token.description: Secret work token from start_task_session for guarded lifecycle recovery. It is forwarded but never echoed in project_work responses.
